negative_results: Mutating any past record makes verify_chain return False for that record and every record downstream of it; the tamper is detected, not repaired.
An observation missing evidence bindings is capped below PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT (collapses to MODEL_PREDICTION) and below evidence level E4; only the capped class enters the record.
A raw Artifact is a frozen dataclass: it cannot be mutated in place, immutable=False is refused, and any changed content produces a different SHA-256 address.
An ExternalArtifactPointer rejects wrong bytes and same-size wrong-hash bytes; an external store is trusted only through a verified hash.
A Derivation with no source artifact or no software name/version is refused.
Nothing is measured: measured_here is 'nothing' and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED; a matching hash is integrity, not authentication and not physics.
reopening_test: tests/v8/test_measurement_ledger.py::test_mutating_a_past_record_breaks_verification_downstream re-runs the full append/verify/tamper cycle deterministically; re-executing the suite (pytest tests/v8/test_measurement_ledger.py -q) reopens and re-checks the phase.
acceptance_checklist: RAW, CALIBRATED, FILTERED, FITTED, INTERPRETED artifact stages separated (ArtifactKind).
Software and parameters recorded for every derivation (Derivation).
Tamper detection implemented via r13.serialize.verify_chain (reused, not duplicated).
External large-file stores supported through verified hashes (ExternalArtifactPointer.verify).
Observations bound to instrument/calibration/specimen/fixture/protocol/clock/environment/uncertainty and capped when incomplete (r15.claims).
Epochs passed in, never wall-clock; deterministic and seeded.
Report exposes claim_class, measured_here='nothing', physical_validation, verdict.
Privacy scan passes: synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs.
Receipt conforms to phase_receipt.schema.json (validated with jsonschema).

claims.statement: An append-only, hash-chained measurement ledger with content-addressed immutable artifacts, hash-verified external pointers, recorded derivations, and binding-driven claim capping is implemented and tested.
claims.claim_cap: MODEL_PREDICTION is the software ceiling; observations missing evidence bindings are capped below PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT and below E4. No physical measurement, device, specimen, or calibration is asserted; measured_here is 'nothing'.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
